DML.SELECT: SELECT locale_code as "localeCode", module_id as "moduleId", label as "label", translation as "translation", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM master.i18n_labels
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO master.i18n_labels (locale_code, module_id, label, translation, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:localeCode, :moduleId, :label, :translation, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
